rule_name: Web Exploit -> Remote Command Execution -> File Dropped in /tmp

tree.name: Kiểm tra HTTP POST Request Mạng
tree.query: MATCH (ip:IPAddress)-[req_rel:REQUESTED]->(req:HTTPRequest) WHERE req.method = 'POST' AND (req.uri CONTAINS '.php' OR req.is_suspicious_payload = true OR req.uri CONTAINS 'upload' OR req.uri CONTAINS 'admin-ajax.php') WITH ip, count(req) AS post_count, max(datetime(req_rel.timestamp)) AS time_post WHERE post_count >= 5 RETURN ip.ip AS attacker_ip, post_count, toString(time_post) AS time_post

on_match.alert_message: ⚠️ [LOW] Phát hiện IP {attacker_ip} gửi liên tục {post_count} HTTP POST nghi vấn lúc {time_post}

next.name: Kiểm tra Tiến Trình Thực Thi Lệnh Shell
next.query: MATCH (ip:IPAddress {ip: $attacker_ip})-[req_rel:REQUESTED]->(req:HTTPRequest) MATCH (p_web:Process)-[spawn_rel:SPAWNED]->(p_sh:Process) WHERE (p_web.exe CONTAINS 'apache' OR p_web.comm CONTAINS 'apache' OR p_web.exe CONTAINS 'php') AND (p_sh.exe IN ['/bin/sh', '/bin/bash', 'python', 'perl', 'nc'] OR p_sh.comm IN ['sh', 'bash', 'python', 'perl', 'nc']) AND datetime(spawn_rel.timestamp) >= datetime(req_rel.timestamp) - duration('PT2H') AND datetime(spawn_rel.timestamp) <= datetime(req_rel.timestamp) + duration('PT12H') RETURN p_sh.exe AS sh_exe, p_sh.pid AS sh_pid, toString(max(datetime(spawn_rel.timestamp))) AS time_rce

on_match.alert_message: 💥 [HIGH] RCE: IP {attacker_ip} thực thi lệnh từ xa qua tiến trình {sh_exe} (PID {sh_pid}) lúc {time_rce}!

next.name: Kiểm tra Ghi File Độc Hại Vào Thư Mục Tạm /tmp
next.query: MATCH (p:Process {pid: $sh_pid})-[:SPAWNED|EXECUTED*0..3]->(p2:Process)-[w:WRITE]->(f:File) WHERE f.path STARTS WITH '/tmp/' OR f.path STARTS WITH '/var/tmp/' RETURN f.path AS dropped_file, toString(max(datetime(w.timestamp))) AS time_drop

on_match.alert_message: 🚨 [CRITICAL] Tiến trình RCE vừa thả file độc hại vào thư mục tạm: {dropped_file} lúc {time_drop}!
